ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.INTRO_TEXT: I am a passionate Fullstack Developer who completed an intensive frontend and backend development program at Developer Akademie. My journey has taught me resilience, adaptability, and the value of continuous growth. Throughout this path, I built various projects and gained hands-on experience turning ideas into functional, user-friendly web applications.
ABOUT.INTRO_CTA: Let's connect and create something amazing together!
ABOUT.FEATURE_LOCATION: Based in Erfurt, I am open to remote work and collaboration with teams from different locations. I enjoy sharing knowledge, learning from others, and contributing to successful projects.
ABOUT.FEATURE_MINDSET: I believe that learning never stops in tech. That's why I continuously expand my knowledge, explore new technologies, and challenge myself to grow as a developer.
ABOUT.FEATURE_METHOD: I approach challenges with analytical thinking, persistence, and creativity. When I encounter a problem, I break it down into manageable steps, research possible solutions, and keep refining my approach until I achieve the best result.

SKILLS.TITLE: Skills
SKILLS.DESCRIPTION_1: I build full-stack web applications with responsive Angular/TypeScript frontends and robust Python/Django backends.
SKILLS.DESCRIPTION_2: To keep up with the rapid changes in web development, I actively invest in continuous learning, clean architecture, and modern agile practices.
SKILLS.CTA_TEXT: I am always excited to learn new technologies and take on new challenges. Adaptability, curiosity, and continuous growth are at the core of my development journey.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Portfolio
PROJECTS.SUBTITLE: Explore a selection of my work here - interact with projects to see my skills in action.
PROJECTS.POLLO_DESC: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
PROJECTS.JOIN_DESC: Task manager inspiried by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
PROJECTS.CODERR_DESC: Freelancer platform with Django backend, API functionality, and seamless frontend integration.
PROJECTS.VIDEOFLIX_DESC: Netflix-style streaming platform with secure auth, custom models, and video processing.
PROJECTS.TESTIMONIAL_TEXT_1: Jérôme is a very versatile and competent colleague with an exceptionally broad range of expertise. What’s particularly impressive is how confidently he navigates different areas and quickly finds effective solutions, even for complex tasks. Thanks to his versatility and reliable nature, he is a true asset to any team.
PROJECTS.TESTIMONIAL_TEXT_2: Collaborating with Jérôme on the Join project was defined by reliability, deep engagement, and mutual respect. Jérôme constructively contributed his own ideas, took full ownership of the agreed tasks, and actively participated in shared decisions. Even during challenges, we could completely rely on each other and develop fitting solutions together. This made Jérôme a valuable asset to our team.
PROJECTS.TESTIMONIAL_TEXT_3: Jérôme supported me time and again throughout our group work. Developing solutions together felt easy with him because he approached challenges with an open, constructive, and goal-oriented mindset. His approach not only made the collaboration smoother but truly enriched it. I am glad to have had the opportunity to work with him.

CONTACT.DESCRIPTION_1: I’m looking to join a development team as a Fullstack Developer and am also open to challenging project support.
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION_2: I build software thoughtfully from the database to the user interface, with a focus on reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver value from day one.
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION_3: If you’re looking for someone who thinks ahead, solves technical challenges reliably, and takes ownership of the end product, let’s talk!
